content.what_it_is: Third-party MATLAB utility function (Pekka Kumpulainen, Tampere University of Technology, dated 21.5.2012; L25-L26) bundled with the multi_vessel_morphology case to create subplot axes with adjustable gaps and margins. Signature [ha, pos] = tight_subplot(Nh, Nw, gap, marg_h, marg_w) (L1) with documented inputs/outputs (L3-L23). Defaults: gap=.02, marg_h=.05, marg_w=.05 when omitted (L29-L31); scalar gap/margin arguments are expanded to 2-element [h w] or [lower upper]/[left right] pairs (L33-L41). Axis height axh=(1-sum(marg_h)-(Nh-1)*gap(1))/Nh and width axw=(1-sum(marg_w)-(Nw-1)*gap(2))/Nw (L43-L44). Starting from py=1-marg_h(2)-axh (L46), a double loop over rows ih and columns ix (L50-L62) creates normalized-unit axes at [px py axw axh] with blanked tick labels (L55-L58), stepping px by axw+gap(2) per column (L59) and py down by axh+gap(1) per row (L61), row-wise from the upper-left like subplot. pos is returned only if requested (L63-L65); ha is returned as a column vector (L66).
entities: ha output axes handle array L1, filled L55, reshaped L66
pos output positions L1, set L64

unresolved: ha is grown dynamically (preallocation commented out at L48); callers in this directory pass gap=[.05 0.5] (large column gap) which with Nw=1 has no effect since gap(2) is only used when Nw>1 (L44, L59)
axes are created with blanked XTickLabel/YTickLabel (L57-L58); callers must restore labels if needed — the doc example (L21-L23) shows this
